packages.title: Endotypes
packages.desc: A group of rare diseases of the junction between nerve and muscle, 35 genes and 12 endotypes: how a random walk and a tree that splits only when the data say so find them.
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of how disease endotypes are found, from a nerve-muscle junction to a protein network

packages.title: One scan, one system
packages.desc: A PET scan sees every organ's sugar use at once. 658 scans make a network of organs that thins and tips towards a few hubs as health erodes; the aim is to read one scan against such a network.
packages.page: One scan, one system: the body as a metabolic network
packages.sub: the body as a metabolic network
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of whole-body PET scans and the network of the organs' metabolism

packages.title: The aging ovary
packages.desc: Sections of 255 ovaries from donors aged 20 to 70, read by deep learning: follicles run out, scars pile up and blood vessels grow fewer. Two methods, one picture of aging.
packages.page: The aging ovary: what 255 ovaries show about aging
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of how the human ovary changes with age, seen through deep learning on 255 tissue sections

packages.title: Three qubits
packages.desc: Some diseases need two genes broken at once. To search the pairs on a quantum computer, a gene network is cut down to eight cells on three qubits, and its moves into a few building blocks.
packages.page: Three qubits: how a gene network fits on a tiny quantum computer
packages.sub: a gene network on a tiny quantum computer
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of how a gene network is shrunk onto three qubits and broken into building blocks a quantum computer runs

packages.title: The mutation machine
packages.desc: DNA changes letter by letter as it is copied. A rule for those changes becomes a machine of gears on a quantum computer, one per branch of a family tree, and pairs of letters that change together are coupled.
packages.page: The mutation machine: DNA's changes as a quantum circuit
packages.sub: DNA's changes as a quantum circuit
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of how DNA letters change along a family tree and how a quantum circuit models it, from a rule of change to an RNA stem

packages.title: Holding on to nitrogen
packages.desc: Less than half of the fertiliser a farmer spreads ends up in the crop. In a field trial in Japan, a wheat with a trait from a wild grass stays greener and leaks less nitrate, while the soil's microbes follow the fertiliser far more than the wheat.
packages.page: Holding on to nitrogen: a wheat, its soil and the microbes in between
packages.sub: a wheat, its soil and its microbes
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story of how soil microbes turn fertiliser into nitrate and nitrous oxide, a wheat bred to slow them down, and the network of microbes in a field trial

packages.title: Flock
packages.desc: 200 starlings at dusk, flying all around you. Each follows its seven nearest neighbours: a network that never stands still.
packages.page: A flock of starlings, all around you
packages.aria: Interactive 3D flock of starlings flying around you at dusk

packages.title: Robot gang
packages.desc: A gang of robot vacuums in your room. In a headset they find your floor and walls, follow you about and bounce off the walls.
packages.page: A gang of robot vacuums in your room
packages.aria: Interactive 3D room with a gang of robot vacuums that follow you about

packages.title: Your guide
packages.desc: A robot guide shows you how the app works in a headset: pointing, playing a story, exploring, the menu and shared rooms. Then a few tasks to practise.
packages.page: Tutorial: a robot guide shows you round
packages.sub: a robot guide shows you round
packages.aria: Interactive 3D tutorial in which a robot guide shows how to use the app in a headset

packages.title: Cell stress test
packages.desc: The cell map's model cell filled with up to 20,000 made-up proteins and 80,000 links, to read a headset's frame rate at each size.
packages.aria: Interactive 3D test: the cell map's model cell with many made-up proteins and links

packages.title: Six handshakes
packages.desc: Sixty people in a ring, and how a few shortcuts bring everyone close: the example story package.
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story: Six handshakes, small-world networks

packages.title: Back into the cell
packages.desc: An interactome of 13,460 proteins put back into a cell: which of its links can happen where, and why it is so hard to tell.
packages.aria: Interactive 3D story: an interactome put back into a model cell
packages.authors: Jörg Menche and colleagues (the interactome); the Human Protein Atlas (the locations); the app's authors
